title: The Bishop Is Too Far
setup: Black's bishop on b6 watches d8 along the diagonal while the rook on f5 has drifted away from home.
hint: A long-range defender still has to be able to come back. Test whether the square it watches is one it can hold.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop guards d8 from a distance, so {{Rd8+}} costs a rook and {{Bxd8}} is forced. Now the diagonal is empty and {{Qxd8#}} takes the square. Guarding a square and being able to survive on it are different things.
